name: Hymmir Urath
source: Pathfinder Adventure: Crown of the Kobold King

defensiveAbilities.name: Void Healing
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

A creature with void healing draws health from void energy rather than vitality energy. It is damaged by vitality damage and is not healed by vitality healing effects. It does not take void damage, and it is healed by void effects that heal undead.

offensiveAbilities.name: Consume Flesh
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements The ghoul is adjacent to the corpse of a creature that died within the last hour.

Effect The ghoul devours a chunk of the corpse and regains 3d6 Healing Damage Hit Points.

It can regain Hit Points from any given corpse only once.

offensiveAbilities.name: Ghoul Fever
offensiveAbilities.description:
Saving Throw DC 22 Fortitude Saving Throw

Stage 1 carrier with no ill effect (1 day)

Stage 2 2d6 Void Damage damage and regains half as many Hit Points from all healing (1 day)

Stage 3 as stage 2 (1 day)

Stage 4 2d6 Void Damage damage and gains no benefit from healing (1 day)

Stage 5 as stage 4 (1 day)

Stage 6 dead, and rises as a Ghoul the next midnight.

offensiveAbilities.name: Gnaw and Chew
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements Hymmir is in a hungry rage

Effect Hymmir attempts a jaws Strike. If he hits, he chews at his target and inflicts an additional 1d6 slashing damage. Hymmir regains 3d6 Healing Damage Hit Points.

offensiveAbilities.name: Hungry Rage
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger Hymmir damages a living creature with his jaws Strike

Effect The taste of flesh and blood throws Hymmir into a violent rage. He gains 9 temporary Hit Points, deals an additional 2 damage with melee Strikes, and takes a -1 penalty to AC for 1 minute.

Effect: Rage

offensiveAbilities.name: Paralysis
offensiveAbilities.description: Any living, non-elf creature hit by a ghoul's attack must succeed at a DC 22 Fortitude Saving Throw save or become Paralyzed. It can attempt a new save at the end of each of its turns, and the DC cumulatively decreases by 1 on each such save.

offensiveAbilities.name: Swift Leap
offensiveAbilities.description: The ghoul jumps up to half its Speed. This movement doesn't trigger reactions.
